name: avegancafe
description: Kyle's personal Claude plugin: a home for one-offs that don't warrant their own plugin. Ships the work-notes-vault skill (his private Obsidian work vault and its Granola meeting archive) and a session-title mod that keeps session titles in `type(Scope): imperative summary` form, titled once from your first prompt, with `/autoname` to re-title from the session's history on demand.
